# Sidak Dhingra

> Full-stack Developer, 23, based in India. Currently working as a Software Developer at QuadLabs, building web applications while also spending my time outside work building my own projects, exploring new ideas, and experimenting with different technologies.

Design-curious and drawn to creating simple, thoughtful interfaces. Less interested in whether an agent gets the right answer than in why it got there.
